READ THE EVIDENCE

A survey map. With the evidence in view.

01 / A hierarchical readingRead from left to right: root baselines lead to methods evaluated against them. Columns indicate comparison depth. In concentric mode, baseline context forms the outer ring and VQ survey methods occupy inner rings, with deeper comparison chains placed farther inward. Both layouts minimize sampled curve length using three starting orders, constrained node swaps and local compaction. Multiple parents and cyclic comparisons are retained.

02 / Methods and shared baselinesEach application includes its survey papers and their baselines, including methods from other applications even when used by just one paper. No minimum number of compared papers is required. Citation relations and bibliography mappings are identified separately.

03 / One experiment at a timeArrows run from baselines to compared methods. Light dotted, light solid, dark solid, and thick dark solid lines indicate increasing absolute relative change. Representative records prioritize NDCG@10, then Beauty, then stable field ordering. No maximum selection or averaging across protocols.

04 / Attribution mattersSystem gains do not isolate the effect of VQ. Inspect protocols, values, and original attribution notes for each comparison. Zero and negative changes remain available in the evidence panel.
